contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: For your first SHEIN order, use 4CW5Y, Cecília's referral code: search the code in the app or on the website and see a selection of products, promotions and discounts. How much and on which pieces is up to SHEIN. It does not go in the coupon field, and it works for returning customers too.

contentSections.heading: SHEIN first order coupon: what to use
paragraphs: For your first SHEIN order, use 4CW5Y, Cecília's referral code: you search it in the search bar of the app or website, not in the coupon field.

Some coupon sites advertise first-order amounts with no SHEIN source behind them: before counting on one, check it on SHEIN itself. The campaigns currently running are on our [SHEIN coupon](/en/coupons/shein) page.

contentSections.heading: A referral code is not a checkout coupon
paragraphs: 4CW5Y does not go in the cart's coupon field. Searched in the app or on the website, it opens the SHEIN page linked to the code: a selection of promotions and discounts.
The store says the perks appear on campaign and product pages and change often. How much and on which pieces is up to SHEIN.
So, when you build your cart, check the final price of each item before you pay.

contentSections.heading: On later orders, the code still works
paragraphs: For later orders, the code is the same: 4CW5Y keeps working as a referral code.
The page opens even without logging in: the code does not depend on it being your first order.

contentSections.heading: Where to search the code
paragraphs: Three steps, in the SHEIN app or on the website:
bullets: Search 4CW5Y in the search bar of the app or website.
Pick your items from the page that opens.
postParagraphs: The shortest way is the store button here in the guide: Cecília's link already opens the 4CW5Y page, with nothing to copy. The step-by-step with the search screens is in [SHEIN referral code: where to enter it and how it works](/en/reviews/shein-referral-code-where-to-enter).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is there a SHEIN first order coupon? For your first order, Cecília's code is 4CW5Y, a referral code: search it in the app or on the website and see the selection the search opens.
Is 4CW5Y a coupon? No. It is a referral code, searched in the app or on the website, and it does not go in the cart's coupon field.
Does 4CW5Y work for customers who have already ordered? Yes. The code also works on later orders, and the search does not require a login.
Does 4CW5Y work on the website and in the app? Yes, on both: the search in the app and on the website open the code's page.
